_comment: 错误码的英文 title/msg（i18n 英文层）。中文是唯一事实来源（errors/codes.sml -> site/static/errors.json）；本文件只补英文，由 errors/gen_js_errors.py 合并生成 js/sml-errors.mjs。缺失的码自动回退中文。键=错误码，值={title,msg}。

E-CLI-001.title: Unknown input format
E-CLI-001.msg: The input format value is unknown

E-CLI-002.title: Unknown output format
E-CLI-002.msg: The output format value is unknown

E-CLI-003.title: Invalid argument combination
E-CLI-003.msg: Invalid command-line argument combination: mutually exclusive options given together, or a required dependency is missing

E-CLI-004.title: lint applies to SML documents only
E-CLI-004.msg: lint can only check SML documents

E-CLI-005.title: Directory mode requires an output directory
E-CLI-005.msg: Directory batch mode requires an output directory

E-CLI-006.title: Rule document parse or build failed
E-CLI-006.msg: Failed to parse or build the custom generation rule document

E-CLI-007.title: Output backend error
E-CLI-007.msg: Output backend error (see the original error for the inner cause)

E-CLI-008.title: Command-line usage error
E-CLI-008.msg: Command-line usage error: unknown argument, missing value, or invalid value

E-CONTRACT-002.title: Field type mismatch
E-CONTRACT-002.msg: Field type should be the expected type, but is another type

E-CONTRACT-003.title: Required field missing
E-CONTRACT-003.msg: The field is required but missing

E-CONTRACT-004.title: Undeclared field (strict mode)
E-CONTRACT-004.msg: Field is not declared in the contract; to allow extra fields, write loose after the contract name

E-CONTRACT-005.title: Value out of range
E-CONTRACT-005.msg: Field value is below the lower bound or above the upper bound

E-CONTRACT-006.title: Invalid enum value
E-CONTRACT-006.msg: The value is not in the enum list

E-CONTRACT-007.title: External type check failed
E-CONTRACT-007.msg: The field does not satisfy the extension type's requirements

E-CONTRACT-008.title: Composite field should be a block
E-CONTRACT-008.msg: The field should be a block validated against that contract, but is not a block

E-CONTRACT-009.title: Custom type format mismatch
E-CONTRACT-009.msg: The field value does not match the type's format requirements

E-CONTRACT-010.title: Numeric constraint value is non-finite
E-CONTRACT-010.msg: The field value is non-finite and cannot be used as a numeric constraint

E-CONTRACT-011.title: External modifier check failed
E-CONTRACT-011.msg: The field does not satisfy the extension modifier's requirements

E-CONTRACT-012.title: Unknown array element type
E-CONTRACT-012.msg: The array element type name is unknown and is not a registered extension type

E-CONTRACT-013.title: Invalid pattern definition
E-CONTRACT-013.msg: Invalid pattern definition: unknown character class, unknown quantifier, unsupported element, or unrecognizable element

E-CONTRACT-014.title: Invalid pattern rule reference
E-CONTRACT-014.msg: Invalid pattern rule reference: references an undefined rule, or the rule references itself cyclically

E-CONTRACT-015.title: Invalid quantifier value
E-CONTRACT-015.msg: Invalid quantifier value: not an integer, negative, or the upper bound is less than the lower bound

E-CONTRACT-016.title: Contract mixin conflict
E-CONTRACT-016.msg: The same field has inconsistent type, default, or range across the two mixed-in contracts

E-CONTRACT-017.title: Contract mixin not implemented
E-CONTRACT-017.msg: This implementation does not support applying several contracts to one block; split into single contracts or wait

E-DERIVE-001.title: Value/target type mismatch
E-DERIVE-001.msg: The SML value's type does not match the target host type

E-DERIVE-002.title: Number out of target type range
E-DERIVE-002.msg: The number is out of the target host type's range

E-DERIVE-003.title: Unknown enum value or variant
E-DERIVE-003.msg: Unknown enum value or enum variant

E-DERIVE-004.title: Enum variant shape mismatch
E-DERIVE-004.msg: The enum variant's shape does not match the target definition

E-DERIVE-005.title: Non-string key during serialization
E-DERIVE-005.msg: Object keys must be strings during serialization

E-DERIVE-006.title: Host feature not enabled
E-DERIVE-006.msg: This capability requires enabling the corresponding host build feature

E-DERIVE-007.title: Invalid derive attribute or type shape
E-DERIVE-007.msg: Invalid derive-macro attribute or type shape (compile-time error)

E-DERIVE-008.title: Derive entry parse failed
E-DERIVE-008.msg: SML parsing failed during derive deserialization (see the original error for the inner cause)

E-EDITOR-001.title: Parser load failed
E-EDITOR-001.msg: The editor-side parser failed to load; completion and diagnostics are unavailable

E-EDITOR-002.title: Highlight config load failed
E-EDITOR-002.msg: Failed to load or parse the highlight configuration

E-EDITOR-003.title: Cannot format
E-EDITOR-003.msg: Cannot format: the document has parse errors

E-EDITOR-004.title: No workspace open
E-EDITOR-004.msg: Please open a workspace folder first

E-EXT-001.title: Unregistered directive, type, or modifier
E-EXT-001.msg: The directive, type, or modifier is not registered in this environment

E-EXT-002.title: Extension registration name conflict
E-EXT-002.msg: Cannot register an extension with a built-in name; duplicate registration also errors

E-EXT-003.title: External directive missing value
E-EXT-003.msg: The external directive's parameter name is missing a value

E-EXT-004.title: External directive returned non-object
E-EXT-004.msg: The external directive's merge result must be an object

E-EXT-005.title: External modifier missing value
E-EXT-005.msg: The external modifier expects a value

E-EXT-006.title: Invalid custom rule document
E-EXT-006.msg: Invalid custom generation rule document: missing rules, empty rules, or a rule missing its template

E-EXT-007.title: Invalid editor customization document
E-EXT-007.msg: Invalid editor customization document: scope name, rule anchor, or color value does not follow the spec

E-EXT-008.title: External directive execution failed
E-EXT-008.msg: The external directive failed while processing this input

E-FEATURE-001.title: Feature not enabled
E-FEATURE-001.msg: This syntax requires the corresponding feature; enable it first

E-FEATURE-002.title: Environment variables disabled
E-FEATURE-002.msg: The current feature set disables environment-variable inlining; bare words or strings cannot be parsed

E-FEATURE-004.title: Invalid version declaration
E-FEATURE-004.msg: Unsupported version declaration, or conflicting version declarations

E-FEATURE-005.title: Bare word must be quoted
E-FEATURE-005.msg: Strings must be quoted: the current feature set disables bare-word strings

E-FEATURE-007.title: feature directive missing argument
E-FEATURE-007.msg: The `@feature` directive is missing an argument

E-FEATURE-008.title: Invalid feature mode argument
E-FEATURE-008.msg: The `@feature mode` argument must be either whitelist or blacklist

E-FEATURE-009.title: No overlap with allowed feature set
E-FEATURE-009.msg: The document's requested features have no overlap with the caller's allowed set

E-INCLUDE-001.title: include file missing or read failed
E-INCLUDE-001.msg: include cannot locate or read the target file

E-INCLUDE-003.title: include out-of-bounds rejected
E-INCLUDE-003.msg: The include target is outside the base directory; rejected

E-INCLUDE-004.title: include nesting exceeds limit
E-INCLUDE-004.msg: include nesting exceeds the maximum depth

E-INCLUDE-005.title: Invalid key-list syntax
E-INCLUDE-005.msg: Invalid key-list syntax: expected a key list, or the list is empty, or missing closing

E-INCLUDE-007.title: Fragment expansion is not an object
E-INCLUDE-007.msg: The fragment expansion result is not an object and cannot be merged into the block

E-INCLUDE-008.title: Partial reference missing target file
E-INCLUDE-008.msg: A partial reference must be followed by a target file

E-INCLUDE-009.title: Partial reference cannot use wildcard
E-INCLUDE-009.msg: A partial reference cannot be combined with glob or regex wildcards; specify a single file

E-INCLUDE-010.title: Base directory unresolvable
E-INCLUDE-010.msg: The include base directory cannot be resolved; the out-of-bounds check is impossible, so parsing stops

E-INCLUDE-012.title: Invalid include path syntax
E-INCLUDE-012.msg: Invalid include path syntax (unquoted or containing illegal characters)

E-INTERNAL-001.title: Internal error
E-INTERNAL-001.msg: Internal error: reached a branch that should be unreachable

E-INTERNAL-002.title: Built-in resource corrupted
E-INTERNAL-002.msg: Built-in resource corrupted (packaging or build accident)

E-IO-003.title: Write or mkdir failed
E-IO-003.msg: Failed to write the file or create the directory

E-IO-005.title: No input detected
E-IO-005.msg: No input detected: neither an input file nor readable pipe input was given

E-IO-006.title: Standard input read failed
E-IO-006.msg: Failed to read standard input, or the channel broke

E-IO-007.title: External tool unavailable or failed
E-IO-007.msg: The external tool is unavailable (not installed or cannot start), or its build failed

E-LEX-002.title: Unterminated block comment (slash-star)
E-LEX-002.msg: Unterminated block comment; reached end of file

E-LEX-003.title: Unterminated block comment (underscore-star)
E-LEX-003.msg: Unterminated block comment; reached end of file

E-LEX-004.title: Unknown escape in string
E-LEX-004.msg: Unknown escape sequence in string; see the spec for the escape set

E-LEX-005.title: Invalid Unicode escape
E-LEX-005.msg: Invalid Unicode escape (too few digits, non-hexadecimal, or illegal code point)

E-LEX-006.title: Escape before end of file
E-LEX-006.msg: An escape sequence is followed by end of file inside the string

E-LIMIT-001.title: Nesting too deep
E-LIMIT-001.msg: Nesting exceeds this implementation's depth limit; suspected recursion or malicious input

E-LIMIT-002.title: Pattern match over step budget
E-LIMIT-002.msg: Pattern matching exceeded the step budget; suspected pathological rule or overlong input

E-LIMIT-003.title: include expansion over limit
E-LIMIT-003.msg: include expansions exceeded the limit; suspected exponential blow-up

E-LIMIT-004.title: Output recursion depth over limit
E-LIMIT-004.msg: Recursion depth exceeds the limit (translation backend)

E-LIMIT-005.title: custom output length over limit
E-LIMIT-005.msg: custom generator output exceeds the length limit (the template amplifies)

E-LIMIT-006.title: custom array loop over limit
E-LIMIT-006.msg: custom generator array exceeds the loop limit

E-LIMIT-007.title: Pattern source length over limit
E-LIMIT-007.msg: The pattern (regex) source exceeds the length limit; compilation refused

E-LIMIT-008.title: Value-to-check length over limit
E-LIMIT-008.msg: The string to check exceeds the length limit; validation refused

E-LIMIT-009.title: Quantifier value over limit
E-LIMIT-009.msg: The quantifier's repeat count exceeds the limit

E-LINT-001.title: Tab in indentation
E-LINT-001.msg: A tab appears in indentation: SML is indentation-sensitive, use spaces consistently

E-MIGRATE-001.title: Text content at top level
E-MIGRATE-001.msg: The imported document has text content at the top level (only whitespace is allowed)

E-MIGRATE-002.title: Unclosed tag
E-MIGRATE-002.msg: Unclosed tag: the file ends inside a tag

E-MIGRATE-004.title: Mismatched end tag
E-MIGRATE-004.msg: The end tag does not match the start tag, or the end tag is missing its closing symbol

E-MIGRATE-005.title: Extra end tag
E-MIGRATE-005.msg: Extra end tag: no matching start tag

E-MIGRATE-006.title: Invalid attribute-area syntax
E-MIGRATE-006.msg: Invalid attribute-area syntax: illegal character, missing equals, unquoted value, or unclosed quote

E-MIGRATE-007.title: Unclosed comment or declaration
E-MIGRATE-007.msg: Unclosed comment, processing instruction, DOCTYPE, or CDATA section

E-MIGRATE-008.title: Unsupported declaration or PI
E-MIGRATE-008.msg: This declaration or processing instruction is not supported here

E-MIGRATE-009.title: Unterminated or unknown entity
E-MIGRATE-009.msg: Unterminated entity, or an unsupported entity name was used

E-MIGRATE-010.title: Illegal entity number
E-MIGRATE-010.msg: The entity's numeric part is illegal (non-hexadecimal, or not a valid code point)

E-MIGRATE-011.title: Invalid TOML syntax
E-MIGRATE-011.msg: Invalid TOML syntax: not key-value form, empty key, missing value, or missing equals in an inline table

E-MIGRATE-012.title: TOML table definition conflict
E-MIGRATE-012.msg: TOML table definition conflict: the name already exists and is not a table, or is not a table array

E-MIGRATE-013.title: Invalid YAML structure
E-MIGRATE-013.msg: Invalid YAML structure: unexpected content, not key-value form, indentation too deep, or extra characters after a flow structure

E-MIGRATE-015.title: Undefined YAML alias
E-MIGRATE-015.msg: The YAML alias references an undefined anchor

E-MIGRATE-016.title: Invalid UTF-8 in YAML
E-MIGRATE-016.msg: Invalid UTF-8 inside a YAML flow structure

E-MIGRATE-017.title: Not valid JSON
E-MIGRATE-017.msg: The imported text is not valid JSON (or nested too deeply)

E-MIGRATE-018.title: Unknown YAML escape
E-MIGRATE-018.msg: An unknown escape sequence appears in a YAML double-quoted string

E-PARSE-001.title: Unclosed block or array
E-PARSE-001.msg: Unclosed block or array; reached end of file

E-PARSE-002.title: Closing symbol mismatch
E-PARSE-002.msg: Block or array not closed properly: expected one symbol but got another

E-PARSE-003.title: Extra closing symbol
E-PARSE-003.msg: Extra closing symbol with no matching opening symbol

E-PARSE-004.title: Stray at sign
E-PARSE-004.msg: A stray at sign is not a valid directive (no whitespace allowed between the sign and the name)

E-PARSE-005.title: Not a valid directive and missing fragment body
E-PARSE-005.msg: The directive name is not a valid directive and is missing a fragment body

E-PARSE-006.title: Expected key or identifier
E-PARSE-006.msg: Expected a key or identifier, but got another token

E-PARSE-007.title: Comma inside a bare word
E-PARSE-007.msg: Unexpected comma: a bare word cannot contain a comma; use an array or wrap it in quotes

E-PARSE-008.title: Top-level scalar not round-trippable
E-PARSE-008.msg: The top level must be a container (key-value block, object block, or array); a lone scalar cannot round-trip

E-PARSE-009.title: Illegal namespace segment
E-PARSE-009.msg: The namespace segment cannot use this name

E-PARSE-010.title: Illegal key name
E-PARSE-010.msg: The key name cannot use this name

E-PARSE-011.title: Missing name after at sign
E-PARSE-011.msg: A name must follow the at sign (directive name or fragment name)

E-PARSE-012.title: Syntax error (fallback)
E-PARSE-012.msg: Syntax error: no more specific reason could be given

E-PARSE-013.title: Interpolation not allowed in key position
E-PARSE-013.msg: $ interpolation is not allowed in key position: loop variables may only be used in value position

E-PARSE-014.title: Invalid when condition
E-PARSE-014.msg: Invalid @when condition: missing condition, the left side is not an environment variable, or the variable name is missing

E-PARSE-015.title: when missing comparison value
E-PARSE-015.msg: The @when comparison operator is missing its comparison value

E-PARSE-016.title: Consecutive when
E-PARSE-016.msg: @when appears consecutively: it only applies to the immediately following field or block

E-PARSE-017.title: when not followed by field or block
E-PARSE-017.msg: @when is not followed by any field or block

E-PARSE-018.title: Invalid for syntax
E-PARSE-018.msg: Invalid @for syntax: missing loop variable, missing in, missing enum items, or missing loop body

E-PARSE-019.title: Invalid directive header
E-PARSE-019.msg: Invalid directive header: @contract / @is / @type is missing a contract name, type name, or pattern body

E-PARSE-020.title: Invalid fragment parameter
E-PARSE-020.msg: Invalid fragment parameter: type or name is missing a value, or the same parameter is repeated

E-PARSE-021.title: default missing value
E-PARSE-021.msg: The default modifier is missing a value

E-PARSE-022.title: Non-numeric numeric bound
E-PARSE-022.msg: The min or max bound value is not a number

E-PARSE-023.title: enum not followed by array
E-PARSE-023.msg: enum must be followed by an array

E-PARSE-024.title: Invalid field spec in contract
E-PARSE-024.msg: Invalid field spec inside a contract definition: empty type, unclosed array or enum, or empty field name

E-PARSE-025.title: Invalid restricted regex
E-PARSE-025.msg: Invalid restricted-regex syntax: a quantifier with no repeatable atom before it, an unclosed character class, or a trailing backslash

I-FEATURE-001.title: CLI feature/parser version mismatch
I-FEATURE-001.msg: The parser works in its fixed version mode; the CLI's declared feature version is advisory only

W-EDITOR-001.title: Custom word conflicts with official keyword
W-EDITOR-001.msg: A custom word conflicts with an official keyword; ignored

W-FEATURE-001.title: Positional-argument form deprecated
W-FEATURE-001.msg: The positional-argument form is deprecated; prefer the named-parameter form

W-LINT-001.title: Fragment never referenced
W-LINT-001.msg: A fragment is defined but never referenced

W-LINT-002.title: Contract never applied
W-LINT-002.msg: A contract is defined but never applied

W-LINT-003.title: Duplicate key in the same block
W-LINT-003.msg: A key is duplicated within the same block; the later one overrides the former

W-LINT-005.title: Nesting exceeds suggested threshold
W-LINT-005.msg: Nesting depth has exceeded the suggested threshold
